business_problem: Migu needed a way to remove device constraints, improve game distribution and retention, and scale a cloud-gaming service that could deliver premium titles without forcing players to own high-end hardware or download large local clients.
solution_summary: Migu Kuaiyou partnered with Baidu AI Cloud around Baidu Cloud Phone and the associated cloud-gaming solution to move game execution from the user's device into the cloud. In this architecture, game applications run on virtual Android phones hosted on cloud servers, while interactive low-latency video streams are delivered back to phones, TVs, PCs, VR devices, and even smart speakers. Baidu contributes ARM-based IaaS capacity, elastic resource scheduling, unified game-save capability, and customizable open architecture, while Migu uses the platform to expose instant-play access to mobile, PC, and console-style titles without requiring local downloads or expensive hardware. Because the game binaries stay in the cloud, the platform also gives Migu stronger content-control and IP-protection options, including immediate takedown when needed.

solution_components.name: Cloud Phone
solution_components.role: Runs virtual phones on cloud servers so games can execute remotely instead of on the player's device.

solution_components.name: Cloud Gaming Solution
solution_components.role: Delivers low-latency game streaming, resource scheduling, save management, and multi-end access for Migu Kuaiyou.

data_flow: Game applications run on Baidu-hosted virtual cloud phones, which render the session in the cloud and stream interactive video back to user devices. Player inputs travel back to the cloud platform, where saves and runtime resources are managed centrally across devices and distribution channels.
business_outcome: Migu scaled a mass-market cloud-gaming platform, expanded to more devices and home terminals, improved user retention, and made premium games instantly accessible without local hardware limits.
metrics: Monthly active users exceeded 20 million by the end of 2019.
The platform made more than 1,000 3A console, PC, and premium mobile games instantly playable.
On Xiaodu speakers, more than 180,000 active users played within just over one month.
About 150,000 Xiaodu users registered as members.
architecture_clues: The platform uses ARM-based IaaS for cloud execution
Centralized execution enables full-process content control and stronger IP protection
Migu built a cross-end product matrix spanning phone, TV, PC, and VR
evidence_quotes: Migu Kuaiyou partnered with Baidu Cloud Phone so players could enjoy cloud gaming and realize the vision of 'gaming anywhere' (original: 咪咕快游与百度云手机的合作，让玩家感受到了云游戏的魅力，也将为游戏行业的爆发带来新的可能。越来越多的游戏上云之后，就可以实现“无处不游戏”的美好愿景).

Baidu provided ARM-based IaaS, low-latency interactive video streaming, refined resource scheduling, and unified game-save capability (original: 百度提供基于 ARM 构架的基础 IaaS 服务能力…实现低时延的视频流的互动能力，精细化地资源调度和统一的游戏存档能力).
Because games connect to users only through video streams, the platform can support stronger content control and IP protection (original: 云游戏全程通过视频流与用户终端的相连…从根本上杜绝了通过破解游戏数据包进行盗版的可能性).

By the end of 2019 Migu Kuaiyou exceeded 20 million monthly active users and offered more than 1,000 instant-play titles; on Xiaodu, 180,000+ active users and 60% retention were reported in just over one month (original: 截至 2019 年底，咪咕快游月活用户数突破 2000 万…千余款 3A 主机和 PC 大作及高品质手游即点即玩 / 短短 1 个多月，小度上玩咪咕快游平台游戏的活跃用户有 18 万多…整体的一个活跃留存达到了60%).
